scope.source_rows: All 363 clean and low-rate same-model endpoint disagreements in counter_retrieval_signal_v2.
scope.unit: One unique victim-model/claim/question-plan case; outputs are reused across poisoning conditions.
scope.same_model_requirement: The model answering without retrieval is the same model that generated and answered the RAG questions.

response_contract.unknown_policy: Use unknown rather than infer an answer from a possibly false premise.

follow_up.comparison: A separately frozen endpoint-hidden semantic comparison will compare both internal repeats with the RAG answer for the identical question.
follow_up.intervention: Only after comparison, remove conflict-selected document identities from the already retrieved context, without new retrieval or backfill, and rerun the standard answer and verdict stages.
follow_up.decision_role: The experiment is diagnostic. It cannot replace the frozen full-claim answerability fallback unless a later guarded rule improves over both that fallback and the selected corroboration candidate with few regressions.
